turnUndoActionTitle: Undo the file changes this turn made
turnUndoReapplyTitle: Put this turn's file changes back
turnUndoUndoneSubtitle: Restored to how they were before this message
turnUndoMessageActionTitle: Undo this response's file changes and keep the conversation
turnUndoDialogDescription: Kun restores only the files this turn changed to how they were before you sent the message. The conversation stays as it is and other files are not touched.
turnUndoBlockedOne: 1 file cannot be restored safely. To avoid overwriting later changes, nothing will be written. Resolve the files marked below and try again.
turnUndoBlockedMany: {{count}} files cannot be restored safely. To avoid overwriting later changes, nothing will be written. Resolve the files marked below and try again.
turnUndoActionRestore: Restore the content from before this turn
turnUndoReasonModifiedAfterTurn: Changed after this turn ended (by you or a later turn). Restoring it would lose those changes.
turnUndoReasonEndStateUnknown: Kun did not record how this file looked when the turn ended (older turns, external agents, generated files), so undo leaves it as is.
turnUndoReasonCheckpointMissing: The checkpoint for this turn was removed by retention or the storage limit.
turnUndoReasonNotInSnapshot: The file was too large to be stored in the checkpoint.
turnUndoReasonGitignored: Git ignores this file, so the checkpoint does not cover it.
turnUndoReasonOutsideWorkspace: The file is outside this repository.
turnUndoReasonUnreadable: The file or its checkpoint copy could not be read.
turnUndoReasonNoNetChange: Already matches its content from before this turn.
turnUndoReasonShellChanged: Changed outside Kun's edit tools (a shell command or a manual edit). Undo does not track it.
turnUndoNothing: This turn left no file changes that can be undone.
turnUndoAdvanced: Advanced: roll the whole workspace back to the checkpoint (git reset --hard)…
turnUndoBusy: Wait for the current task to finish before undoing file changes.
turnUndoReapplyBlockedDescription: These files changed after the undo. To avoid overwriting those changes, nothing was written.
turnUndoConflictSnapshotMissing: The saved copy of this turn's version is missing
rewindResetFilesDetailOne: Restore 1 file changed after this message to how it was before
rewindResetFilesDetailMany: Restore {{count}} files changed after this message to how they were before
rewindResetConversationDetail: Files stay as they are now
rewindResetChecking: Checking files changed after this message…
rewindResetConflictOne: 1 file changed after its turn ended and cannot be restored safely, so only the conversation will be reset. No files will be written.
rewindResetConflictMany: {{count}} files changed after their turn ended and cannot be restored safely, so only the conversation will be reset. No files will be written.
rewindResetFellBack: Files changed while resending, so only the conversation was reset. No files were written.
